no_sign_activities_to_collect: resting and moving hand near chest
incomplete circular sweep not intended as signing
oov_policy: A fluent reviewer must identify the actual sign and variant. Its normalized label must be absent from the installed ASL-2000 plus starter vocabulary. Freeze that vocabulary hash. The evaluation lab loads no personal templates.
consent_and_review: record a private consent or source license record
record a pseudonymous reviewer reference and variant notes
do not commit raw recordings, face imagery or landmarks
freeze SHA-256 and source recording group before replay
split_policy: Reserve whole participants and whole source recordings before observing predictions. Never put crops, re-encodings or alias IDs of one recording or signer in both splits.
holdout_policy: The five reserved PopSign clips remain unviewed and unpredicted. They have publisher labels, no independent fluent-signer review and unknown upstream-training identity overlap; they cannot establish deployment readiness alone.
